name: czl-qimao-novel
description: An independent production line for Qimao (七猫中文网) serial fiction, built around seven stations: genre fit against Qimao's own charts, title/synopsis packaging, a submission outline an editor will not reject for structure, a 20,000-character sample whose first 200 characters are pressure-tested, the 30,000-character launch node, retention-tier placement against Qimao's published full-attendance table, and an attendance cash-flow model that accounts for the 4,000/6,000 daily-word thresholds, the 200,000-character monthly cap and the single allowed leave day. Every station returns a filled work order with a decision (go / rework / stop), the evidence behind it, and the next station's entry condition. Ships six dependency-free Python checkers, eight reference cards and seven work-order templates. Owned and developed by 虫志龙.

displayDescription.en: Writes to Qimao's submission standard: genre fit, a submission pack editors accept, a pressure-tested opening, then retention tier and attendance cash flow in one ledger.
displayDescription.zh: 按七猫签约口径做书：选题踩主收盘，投稿包过编辑，样章过测试，留存分档与全勤现金流一起算清。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a Qimao idea. Run station one on it: does this genre hold up on Qimao's charts, which book should I benchmark against, and do I keep the concept or only the shell?
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我手上有个七猫的选题，先过选品站：这个题材在七猫站不站得住，对标哪本书，我该保留内核还是只换壳？

quickPrompts.en: I have a Qimao idea. Run station one on it: does this genre hold up on Qimao's charts, which book should I benchmark against, and do I keep the concept or only the shell?
quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有个七猫的选题，先过选品站：这个题材在七猫站不站得住，对标哪本书，我该保留内核还是只换壳？

quickPrompts.en: Build me a submission pack I can send to a Qimao editor: title, synopsis, a complete outline, plus the first three chapters of a 20,000-character sample.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我做一份能投给七猫编辑的投稿包：书名、简介、一份写完结局的大纲，再加两万字样章里的前三章。

quickPrompts.en: My read-through at 100,000 characters is only 9%. Tell me which attendance tier that puts me in, how far the next tier is, and which chapters to fix this week.
quickPrompts.zh: 我十万字均留只有 9%，帮我算现在卡在哪一档、离下一档差多少、这周该改哪几章。
